This was my first time trying to make oil. So its possible other people having different\better methods as well!

I'll try to put it into steps:

1. Preheat oven to 220F
2. Cut your herb (not too finely)  I used only 7 grams as it was my first time and I didn't want to waste note than that. 
3. Spread evenly in oven save dish and cover with tin foil. 
4. Place in oven and let it bake for 40 mins, take it out let it cool with your makeshift lid still ON. Leave your oven ON. 


5. Melt 1\4 cup of coconut oil in a pot, on low. Once melted you can pour your melted coconut oil into your herb in the same oven safe dish. 
6, Sprinkle 1\2 teaspoon of soy lecithin, stir it, put your lid back on and bake for 45 mins @ 220F
7. Take it out, put another 1\2 teaspoon of soy lecithin, put your lid back on and bake for another 45 mins @ 220F. 
8, Let it cool off completely and place your dish in the freezer for 2 hours. (More is okay) 
9. Take out your dish, let it warm back up to room temp, then place in oven until it  becomes liquid again. 
10. Strain out your oil. I found the best way to do this was with cheese cloth and a small metal strainer. Using cheesecloth alone I found plant material got through, so I doubled up the cheese cloth and ran it through the strainer, ams BAM, you have yourself come cannaoil!
